title: CRISPR–Cas9: targeting is only half the story
subtitle: RNA-guided recognition locates a break. DNA repair determines what the genome becomes.
description: RNA-guided recognition locates a break. DNA repair determines what the genome becomes.

elements.text: The guide pairs with one DNA strand while Cas9 holds the locally opened duplex.
Strand separation and protein shape are schematic.
Cas9 requires a compatible motif next to the target.
Complementary pairing positions the nuclease. Similar sites can still be cut.
A cut is the beginning of an edit
The cell repairs the break through competing pathways; these are two simplified outcomes.
Different small changes may disrupt gene function; some repairs restore the original sequence.
A defined change can be copied into the target. Cleavage alone does not guarantee this outcome.

footer: Sources: Addgene / NHGRI • Conventional cutting Cas9 • Abstract sequence units, not a target sequence or a molecular-scale model
